reviewStatus: builder artifacts only; independent claims/QA/learner gates outstanding
notes: No sleep, health, medical, food, chemical, heat, electricity, child, pet or financial advice.
Study constructions are single local attempts, not tests of empirical retention effects.
Calendar/queue results use visible stipulated quantities; no promised real productivity gains.
Shared models and components encode several interaction families; each lesson has its own practical objective.

lessons.title: Same hours, different calendar
lessons.objective: Separate the research-supported spacing effect from invented memory curves.
